PP_UpdIntro: PhantomPad looks for new versions when it opens and when you come here. If there is one, you can download it while you play: it is not installed by itself, only when you press "Restart app".
PP_UpdNotConfigured: Updates are not set up yet

PP_UpdAvailableText: You have version {0}. Download it while you play; it is only installed when you restart the app.
PP_UpdManualText: You have version {0}. This copy was not installed with the PhantomPad installer, so download the new version from its page.
PP_UpdDownloadingText: You can keep playing. Nothing is installed until you press "Restart app".
PP_UpdReadyText: Press "Restart app" when you finish playing: PhantomPad closes, installs version {0} and opens again.

PP_UpdNote: Updates come from PhantomPad's official GitHub page. Since PhantomPad is not digitally signed yet, Windows may show a SmartScreen warning when installing it: choose "More info" → "Run anyway".
